description: Source code for a Rust module implementing a resolver with error handling, module key management, and resolution logic for JavaScript modules, including embedded, on-disk, and stub modules.

classes.name: ResolutionError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible errors during module resolution, including file not found, invalid UTF-8, resolve errors, and IO errors.

classes.name: ModuleKey
classes.description: Enumeration representing different types of module sources: embedded, on-disk, or browser stub, with methods to access their contents and source text.

classes.name: Resolver
classes.description: Struct encapsulating a JavaScript module resolver with methods to create new instances and resolve module paths.

methods.name: ResolutionError::fmt
methods.description: Formats the error message for display.

methods.name: ResolutionError::from
methods.description: Converts from other error types into ResolutionError.

methods.name: ModuleKey::contents
methods.description: Retrieves the contents of the module as a byte vector.

methods.name: ModuleKey::source_text
methods.description: Retrieves the source code of the module as a String.

methods.name: Resolver::new
methods.description: Creates a new Resolver instance with default options.

methods.name: Resolver::new_with_cwd
methods.description: Creates a new Resolver instance with a specified current working directory.

methods.name: Resolver::resolve
methods.description: Resolves a module specifier relative to a given path, returning a ModuleKey or error.
